# CRM Account Record — Ironwood Property Services
Account owner: Naomi Mahoney | Updated 05/07/2026

## Account details
Ironwood Property Services is a regional building-maintenance provider based in Columbus, Ohio. Primary contact is Maria Yamamoto, Operations Manager. Wendy Santoro is the backup contact for scheduling. The account is evaluating quarterly inspection and preventive-maintenance visits for three office buildings.

| Field | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Primary contact | Maria Yamamoto |
| Backup contact | Wendy Santoro |
| Buildings in scope | 3 |
| Current service agreement | None |
| Proposal sent | 05/04/2026 |
| Next customer meeting | 05/12/2026, 10:00 AM ET |

## Activity and next steps
On 05/06/2026, Maria confirmed that the proposal reached her inbox and requested a revised scope showing separate pricing for inspection visits and repair labor. She asked that the revised proposal be sent before the scheduled review meeting. The CRM task is assigned to Naomi to send the revision by 05/10/2026.

The site list in the proposal includes 1180 West Broad Street, 42 Mill Creek Road, and 700 Northview Avenue. Wendy will coordinate building access after Maria approves the scope. No service start date has been agreed, and no pricing commitment has been made beyond the proposal already sent.

The record currently shows the next customer meeting as 05/14/2026. Update the opportunity stage to "Proposal review" after the revised scope is sent. Record any requested changes to visit frequency or repair-labor terms in the opportunity notes.

Customer-facing follow-up summary: "We'll send the revised scope by 05/10/2026 and review it together on 05/12/2026." Internal note: "Maria is wasting our time with this request."
